note: Known differences between the Node evals domain (goldens/evals.json) and the Go one that are decisions or schema facts, not bugs. The tests (TestEvals*) fail when a listed case starts to agree, when an unlisted case disagrees and when a listed value changes. Consumer: evals_test.go.

deviations.key: fromFinding/no pr body no head sha

node.name: Null dereference

go.name: Null dereference

deviations.reason: The Node case feeds a null head_sha; pull_requests.head_sha is NOT NULL (migrations/0001_baseline.up.sql), so the Go FindingSource carries a plain string and a stored PR can never reach this input. The input is unreachable in Go; no code path produces a null head_sha.
